items.headline: [SAMPLE] Payments help, but effects fade
bullets: Wetlands held 2 years after payments stopped

plain.question: Do farmers keep protecting wetlands after payments stop?
plain.method: They tracked 400 farms for six years; half were paid, half were not.
plain.finding: Wetland cover held for two years after payments ended, then fell.
plain.why: Short-term payments may not create lasting change.
